decisions.reason: Making the 100-sale draw interval exact does not change ticket issuance, association, display, or post-draw reset behavior.
The existing message-210 MODIFY already states that the $500 drawing occurs every 100 sales without approximation.
The exactness of the draw interval does not change the $15 mint price or the per-sale revenue allocation.
The interval clarification does not change which ticket, badge, referral-code, or association fields must appear in NFT metadata.
The clarification affects the draw frequency, not the qualifying mint trigger, ticket recipient, ticket quantity, or ticket cycle.
The existing message-210 MODIFY already ties automatic Chainlink VRF selection to the applicable 100-sales trigger.
An exact 100-sale interval does not change the no-referral allocation trigger, random recipient selection, or applicable Small Block draw.
Draw-interval exactness does not change automatic direct-wallet delivery or its immediate timing after a win.
The draw-frequency clarification does not alter announcement channels, notification channels, email conditions, or winner guidance.
The source explicitly requests the live label “Next $500 Draw In: ~X Sales”; the exact 100-sale recurrence does not require changing that dynamic countdown label.
The existing message-210 MODIFY already uses exact “every 100 sales” language throughout the landing-page prize copy.
The existing message-210 MODIFY already replaces the approximate About-page interval with one $500 winner from each 100-sales block.
